environment.description: AWS Lambda function deployed as part of a Step Functions state machine. The API Gateway (REST API) fronting the workflow accepts POST requests to /admin/elevate-role. The Lambda execution role has iam:AttachUserPolicy permission with Resource: '*'. No input validation is performed at the API Gateway level. The Step Functions workflow passes the raw API Gateway event payload directly to this Lambda. No SCPs restrict IAM actions in this account.

config.api_gateway: REST API, no request validation, no WAF association
config.step_functions: Express workflow, passes raw input without InputPath filtering
config.network: public API endpoint, no IP restrictions
